title: Google Meet says the camera is in use by another app
setting: Windows 11, Windows PowerShell 5.1, run from the home folder (not a project)
prompt: en google meet lo tengo activo pero dice que la camara de mi pc esta abierta en otra aplicacion pero no tengo mas aplicaciones pues bsicar el error y ver cual aparece abierta?

shelra.result: Named Google Chrome as the app holding the camera, from the webcam consent records, and gave the command that fixed it.

reference.notes: Offered three options in turn; the first two failed and the third was right, which Shelra's answer confirmed.

fixes.what: PowerShell table output was lost (15 empty results), the completion gate did not count running the changed script (3 gate loops), and the prompt had no date.
The prompt asks for independent checks in one step; the session probed one thing per model round.
Helper scripts go to a scratch folder instead of the home folder.

reruns.result: Named the processes with the camera capture engine loaded: the browser and a background sign-in helper.
Generic: most likely a browser tab still holding the camera; no process named.
Named Google Chrome from the camera's privacy-consent records, with its last-use times; answered in Spanish, like the request.
